title: Screenshots native runner rejects the verified CI development artifact receipt
surface: Native Screenshots acceptance harness provenance gate
auth_mode: signed-in admin runner; member runner not established
organization_context: No organization request or product operation occurred; the runner stopped before Chrome startup.
preconditions: Successful exact-source CI development artifact 38316843884 is imported and promoted to .output/chrome-mv3-dev.
test-results/ci-dev-promotion-receipt.json identifies the promotion, source SHA, extension ID, version, and tree hash.
The Screenshots runner is invoked through the resource guard with SCREENSHOT_CAPTURE_DEV_BUILD_RECEIPT pointing to that receipt.
reproduction: Use CI run 38316843884, attempt 1, artifact 11777408625, source fe631ec14c443d025dec04c1fa00795b1feaddb0, version 0.2.509, extension ID cihdmkcdjjckfhjpgoedmgfpoljebaml, and tree hash 2f71dec09b54bb524ee1bf852a7767abed3bc9b49658923f3175a66e9703232a.
Promote the imported artifact using the existing CI development artifact promotion flow; its receipt kind is ci_development_test_promotion and its destination is .output/chrome-mv3-dev.

After resource admission, the runner emits UNVERIFIED screenshot_capture; its sanitized result has status unverified, build null, failure stage build_start, and code owned_harness_or_ui_stage_failed. No browser starts.
expected: The runner validates the CI promotion receipt against the imported/promoted artifact's exact source, extension identity, version, configured destination and tree hash, then proceeds only when every identity check passes.
actual: buildIdentity calls requireLocalDevReceipt, which only accepts local_dev_unpacked receipts. The verified CI promotion receipt is rejected before artifact identity is returned, despite its verified exact-source provenance and matching version/tree.
reproducibility: One guard-admitted attempt deterministically stopped at build_start. A second permit was stopped before admission and browser startup after the provenance issue was identified.
severity: S2: blocks native acceptance of the current CI-built Screenshots artifact
priority: P1: repair before interpreting any new Screenshots native retest
cause: The runner's receipt contract only recognizes local builds, while stabilization now supplies a CI-built and promoted artifact with a distinct promotion receipt kind.
sibling_census: Other native runners may share the local-only receipt assumption; check existing CI artifact consumers before closing this defect. No sibling runner was changed in this task.
acceptance_criteria: Accept only the existing ci_development_test_promotion receipt shape without relabeling it as a local build.
Require exact source SHA for this run and verify promoted destination, version, expected development extension ID, and tree hash against the artifact and promotion receipt.
A wrong source SHA, extension ID, destination, or mutated tree must fail closed before browser startup with a fixed safe diagnostic.
The runner proceeds on the verified CI artifact and records its true CI run, artifact, source, and tree identity in sanitized output.
Independent source review and fresh green focused CI precede another resource-admitted native attempt.

source_verification.native_acceptance: ZERO CREDIT: resource admitted, then rejected before browser startup at build_start. T04/T05 admin and member behaviors remain unverified.

next_action: Repair and independently review the receipt gate using the existing CI promotion contract; obtain a fresh green exact-source artifact before another native attempt.

transition_history.reason: Guard-admitted Screenshots run rejected the verified CI promotion receipt at build_start before browser startup.
Isolated deterministic receipt-kind mismatch; product behavior was not exercised.
